newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's affirms RAMS Series 2 Bond.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's affirms RAMS Series 2 Bond.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had confirmed the Aaa rating to the Series 2 Class A Bonds issued by RAMS Mortgage Corporation Ltd.
This announcement follows the issuance of an additional A$190 million Class A bonds in the series, now increased to a total A$760 million.
Moody's said the rating was based on the level of subordination provided by the Class B Bonds, equal to five percent of the total bonds issued.

Moody's said the rating reflected the mortgage insurance polices which covered default losses in an amount equal to 100 percent of the principal amount of each loan, plus timely interest on the defaulted principal for up to 12 months after default.
It was also based on the protection provided to bondholders by a charge over the Series 2 assets granted to a Security Trustee, Moody's said.

Moody's said the rating also reflected the quality of the collateral in the form of residential mortgage loans and the strength of the legal document setting out the obligations of the various parties in the programme.
